description: This file defines an interface 'IReminderRegistry' for managing grain reminders in Orleans. It includes methods for registering, unregistering, and retrieving reminders, intended to be implemented by classes that handle reminder lifecycle management within Orleans grains.

classes.name: IReminderRegistry
classes.description: An interface for a reminder registry that provides methods to manage reminders in Orleans grains.

methods.name: RegisterOrUpdateReminder
methods.description: Registers a new reminder or updates an existing one with specified timing details.

methods.name: UnregisterReminder
methods.description: Removes a specified reminder from the active grain.

methods.name: GetReminder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reminder by name that is registered to the current grain.

methods.name: GetReminders
methods.description: Gets all reminders registered to the current grain.
